description:
+n does not parse anywhere (probed on fz-rs7.4, PR #358):

def main(), do: dbg(+3)
error[parse/expected-token]: unsupported expression prefix in compiler2 front door: Plus

The same error is reported for def f(n) when +n > 0. Elixir accepts unary plus in bodies and guards (Kernel.+/1, the identity on numbers; ArithmeticError on anything else, and a non-matching clause in a guard).

Change: the parser accepts prefix + and it resolves as a call to Kernel's +/1, the way unary minus resolves through CallableName::negation.

Fails before, passes after, three paths, with an Elixir oracle: +3, +n in a body, +n in a function-head guard and a receive guard, and +:a (raises in a body, clause not matched in a guard).

Acceptance: full gate green.
title: Unary plus parses, in bodies and guards
